name: Junketsu Yori Nao Akaku
source:
Main character's friend who is less that a lover suddenly wants to become an idol. She asks protagonist to become her manager. But she gets deceived by producer and makes her debut as AV actress instead. Shady events change each other.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公有一位与恋人关系尚远的朋友，她突然想成为偶像，并请求主人公担任自己的经纪人。然而，她被制作人欺骗，反而以AV女优身份出道。阴暗事件接连发生。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
